_help: Source file -> testcase workbook mapping for `/system-test source` (python -m qakit.tools.impact). repos: name -> path of the git repo (relative to the autotest root or absolute). rules: pattern = fnmatch on the path inside the repo ('*' also matches '/'); files = workbook numbers (_NN_) or parts of workbook names, '*' = all; level direct = every ID of the workbook, cross = only IDs whose 分類/タイプ contain one of 'tags', broad = warning only. ignore = paths never mapped. ui_globs (optional) = files scanned for removed UI strings.
